title: 第7章 一点小疼不死人第8章 兄弟和睦李庆之
content_zh:
;;
悦来客栈，二楼客房，李子夜前来探望三皇子慕尧，神色之关切，令人动容。
“听说三殿下遇刺受伤，一直想来探望，又怕打扰了殿下养伤，所以，等到了今日才来，还望殿下莫要见怪。”李子夜举起茶杯，轻声说道。
“李兄客气。”
慕尧心中冷哼一声，脸上却没有表现出来，笑道，“李兄能来，我就很高兴了。”
虽然他不知道那夜出手的人是谁，但是，用脚想都能猜出来和李家脱不了干系。
不过，他现在没有证据，如今，也不是和李家翻脸的时候。
“三殿下有何打算，伤好之后，就要回都城了吗？”李子夜试探地问道。
“不急。”
慕尧面露微笑道，“既然来了，我也想看一看这渝州城的风土人情，到时候，免不了还要麻烦李兄。”
李子夜闻言，眸子微微眯起，这白痴，居然还不走了。
“客气，怎么能说麻烦，三殿下愿意留下，我求之不得。”李子夜一脸真诚的笑意，说道。
“多谢。”
慕尧点了点头，犹豫了一下，问道，“对了，有一事，我一直好奇，在都城时我便听说，渝州李家的香水，琉璃还有肥皂生意都是源于李兄幼时的发明，是真的吗？”
“当然，不是。”
李子夜哈哈一笑，道，“殿下怎么还会相信这些传言，李家的香水生意做了十年，十年前，我还是一个不懂事的孩童，又怎能发明创造这些东西，这些不过是说书人用来哄骗无知百姓的噱头罢了。”
“呵。”
慕尧轻笑，道，“看来，我也被这些说书人给骗了。”
说到这里，慕尧端起茶壶，亲自给眼前人倒了一杯茶，仿佛不在意地说道，“这香水和琉璃生意，李家想过要找合作伙伴吗？”
来了！

李子夜听过三皇子的话，眸子顿时一凛，这才是三皇子来渝州城的真正目的。
朝廷，果然想插手他李府的生意。
“合作伙伴？”
李子夜端起三皇子给他倒的茶，喝了一口，面露思索之色，道，“李家的生意，我倒是很少插手，不过听我那长姐说，李府如今的生意确实遇到了瓶颈，若要更进一步，则需要寻找合适的生意伙伴。”
慕尧闻言，嘴角微弯，这两年来，朝廷有意无意在打压李家的生意，虽然收效不大，但是，还是抑制了李家生意的疯狂扩张。
不过，这只是铺垫，朝廷的目的，就是要借机插手李家的生意。
而李府想要继续扩张商业影响，就必须借助朝廷的力量。
“都城倒是有几家不错的选择，财力雄厚，人脉更是不错，李兄若是愿意，我可以为李兄介绍。”慕尧借机说道。
“哦？”
李子夜提起精神，问道，“不知是哪几家？”
“长孙家，商盟，还有尹氏钱庄。”慕尧回答道。
李子夜听过，神色微凝，原来，都城这三个商业巨头，都是朝廷的。
能得到这些消息，此行，也不算白来。
他很清楚，三皇子肯透露这些，并非没有条件，这三家便是皇室给李府的选择，李府不得不选。
至少，在李府和皇室正式撕破脸前，皇室的颜面，李府要给。
“三殿下，此事我要回去和父亲与长姐商议，还望殿下等上一两日，我必定给殿下一个满意的答复。”李子夜起身，神色恭敬道。
“好，我便在此等李兄的好消息。”
慕尧起身相送，一脸笑容地说道。
李子夜点头，旋即匆匆离开。
李府后院，书房。

李百万，李幼薇正在里面核对账本，李子夜一把推开房门，直接走了进去。
“放……肆。”

Yuelai Inn, guest room on the second floor, Li Ziye came to visit the third prince Mu Yao, his expression of concern was touching.
"I heard that His Highness was assassinated and injured. I have always wanted to come to visit, but I was afraid of disturbing His Highness's recovery, so I waited until today to come. I hope Your Highness will not be offended." Li Ziye raised his tea cup and said softly.
"Brother Li, you're welcome."
Mu Yao snorted coldly in his heart, but did not show it on his face. He smiled and said, "I'm very happy that Brother Li can come."
Although he didn't know who made the move that night, he could guess with his feet that it had something to do with the Li family.
However, he has no evidence now, and now is not the time to fall out with the Li family.
"What are your plans for the Third Highness? Will you return to the capital after you recover from your injuries?" Li Ziye asked tentatively.
"No rush."
Mu Yao smiled and said, "Since I'm here, I also want to take a look at the customs and customs of this Yuzhou City. When the time comes, I will inevitably trouble Brother Li."
When Li Ziye heard this, his eyes narrowed slightly. This idiot didn't even leave.
"You're welcome, how can you say it's troublesome? I'm happy for His Highness to stay," Li Ziye said with a sincere smile.
"Thank you."
Mu Yao nodded, hesitated, and asked, "By the way, there is one thing that I have always been curious about. When I was in the capital, I heard that the perfume, glass and soap business of the Li family in Yuzhou were all invented by Brother Li when he was a child. Is it true?"
"Of course, no."
Li Ziye laughed and said, "How could Your Highness still believe these rumors? The Li family has been in the perfume business for ten years. Ten years ago, I was an ignorant child. How could I invent and create these things? These are just gimmicks used by storytellers to deceive ignorant people."
"Heh."
Mu Yao chuckled and said, "It seems that I was also deceived by these storytellers."
Having said this, Mu Yao picked up the teapot, poured a cup of tea for the person in front of him, and said as if he didn't care, "Have the Li family thought about finding a partner for this perfume and glass business?"
Coming!
Li Ziye's eyes suddenly froze after hearing what the third prince said. This was the real purpose of the third prince's visit to Yuzhou City.
The imperial court really wanted to interfere in his Li Mansion's business.
"Partner?"
Li Ziye picked up the tea that the third prince poured for him, took a sip, and said with a thoughtful look on his face, "I rarely interfere in the Li family's business, but I heard from my eldest sister that the Li family's business has indeed encountered a bottleneck. If you want to go further, you need to find a suitable business partner."
Mu Yao's lips curved slightly when he heard this. In the past two years, the imperial court had intentionally or unintentionally suppressed the Li family's business. Although the effect was not great, it still restrained the crazy expansion of the Li family's business.
However, this is just a foreshadowing. The court's purpose is to take the opportunity to intervene in the Li family's business.
If the Li Mansion wants to continue to expand its commercial influence, it must rely on the power of the imperial court.
"There are some good choices in the capital. They have strong financial resources and good connections. If Brother Li is willing, I can introduce them to Brother Li." Mu Yao took the opportunity to say.
"Oh?"
Li Ziye cheered up and asked, "I wonder which company it is?"
"The Changsun family, the merchant alliance, and the Yin family bank." Mu Yao replied.
Li Ziye looked slightly condensed after hearing this. It turned out that the three business giants in the capital were all from the imperial court.
To get this information, this trip is not in vain.
He knew very well that the third prince was willing to reveal these things not without conditions. These three families were the choices given to Li Mansion by the royal family, and Li Mansion had to choose.
At least, before the Li Mansion and the royal family officially break up, the Li Mansion must give the royal family face.
"Your Highness, Third Highness, I have to go back to discuss this matter with my father and eldest sister. I hope Your Highness will wait for a day or two. I will definitely give Your Highness a satisfactory answer." Li Ziye stood up and said respectfully.
"Okay, I'll wait here for the good news from Brother Li."
Mu Yao stood up and said goodbye with a smile on his face.
PlumYe nodded and left in a hurry.
Li's backyard, study room.
Li Baiwan and Li Youwei were checking the account books inside. Li Ziye opened the door and walked in directly.
"presumptuous."
